items.title: Sean Payton goes for his 200th career win on Sunday
items.text: Broncos coach Sean Payton, with five wins in 2026, now sits one win short of a milestone only 11 other NFL coaches have achieved.

items.title: Falcons sixth-round rookie Anterio Thompson says he was told he'll never play again
items.text: Falcons rookie defensive tackle Anterio Thompson, who has been on the non-football injury list since the start of training camp, has disclosed that his career is over.

items.title: Budda Baker says he's focused on the Cowboys, not trade talk
items.text: The trade deadline is Nov. 10, and the Cardinals could be sellers.

items.title: Video seems to contradict Josh Jacobs's explanation of TD celebration
items.text: After Packers running back Josh Jacobs scored his first of two touchdowns on Thursday night, he seemed to celebrate by pretending to be in handcuffs.

items.title: Cowboys list Kenny Clark, George Pickens as questionable
items.text: The Cowboys added defensive tackle Kenny Clark to the injury report on Friday.

items.title: Jaylen Waddle questionable, RJ Harvey ruled out for Broncos-Chiefs
items.text: At this point, it’s still unclear whether or not the Broncos will have receiver Jaylen Waddle for Sunday’s game against the Chiefs.

items.title: Commanders add DT Daron Payne to injury report as questionable
items.text: The Commanders had already ruled out defensive tackle Javon Kinlaw (knee).

items.title: Rams list Trent McDuffie, Coleman Shelton as questionable
items.text: The Rams didn't rule anyone out on their final injury report of the week, but they're not sure they'll have cornerback Trent McDuffie against the Chargers on Sunday.

items.title: Ladd McConkey set to play, Derwin James out vs. Rams
items.text: The Chargers will have two of their key receivers for Sunday's game against the Rams.

items.title: Jeffery Simmons says calling Caleb Williams "Painted Nails" was "just smack talk"
items.text: New Bears defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons said his nickname for Caleb Williams two years ago was nothing more than gamesmanship.

items.title: Dolphins claim DE Jamree Kromah off waivers
items.text: The Dolphins made a roster change a couple of days before their Week 8 game against the Patriots.

items.title: Raiders G Jackson Powers-Johnson is questionable for Sunday

items.title: Titans rule out WR Carnell Tate, RB Tyjae Spears, P Tommy Townsend

items.title: Saquon Barkley set to play, DeVonta Smith ruled out

items.title: Sauce Gardner, Tyler Warren set to play for Colts
items.text: The Colts ended a tumultuous week with a bit of good news about the health of two of their top remaining players.

items.title: Kerby Joseph after return to practice: I'm still him; I hope you all ain't forgot
items.text: The Lions added cornerback Roger McCreary to their injury report Friday.

items.title: Rashee Rice set to play, Mansoor Delane questionable for Chiefs-Broncos
items.text: The Chiefs will have one of their key receivers back when they play the Broncos on Sunday.

items.title: Falcons rule out Brian Robinson, list eight as questionable

items.title: Colston Loveland limited at Bears practice with a neck injury

items.title: Ravens G Vega Ioane ruled out for Week 8
items.text: The Ravens expect to have quarterback Lamar Jackson back in the lineup for Sunday's game against the Bills, but they will be missing one of their starting offensive linemen.

items.title: Browns list three players as questionable, including OT Tytus Howard

items.title: Dave Canales says defensive coaching changes are about the players feeling confident
items.text: Panthers head coach Dave Canales fired defensive coordinator Ejiro Evero and defensive passing game coordinator Jonathan Cooley less than 12 hours after Thursday night's loss to the Packers, and Canales said on Friday afternoon that he wants his players to be confident in their defense.

items.title: Joe Brady: We know we’re going to get the best version of Lamar Jackson
items.text: While it feels like nothing will be truly official until the first snap on Sunday, Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson is now set to start against the Bills after missing Baltimore's last three games with a high ankle sprain.

items.title: Colts sign DT Kevin Givens off of 49ers practice squad
items.text: The Colts traded defensive tackle DeForest Buckner to the 49ers earlier this week and they replaced him on the active roster with a former member of the Niners.

items.title: Kenneth Gainwell, Luke Goedeke questionable for Bucs vs. Falcons
items.text: After rushing for 88 yards last week, Kenneth Gainwell may not be available for Sunday’s game against the Falcons.

items.title: DJ Moore, Dalton Kincaid, Spencer Brown among Bills questionable for Week 8
items.text: It’s still unclear whether or not receiver DJ Moore will return from his shoulder injury for Sunday’s game against the Ravens.

items.title: Cardinals expect Jeremiyah Love to play against Cowboys
items.text: The Cardinals plan to have running back Jeremiyah Love back in the lineup when they face the Cowboys this Sunday.

items.title: Lamar Jackson plans to play on Sunday
items.text: Jackson has missed the last three games with a hamstring injury.
